## Summary

Fixed the issue in `lib/core/AxiosHeaders.js` (mirroring the upstream v1.2.0 fix for #5085):

1. **`normalizeValue`** (lib/core/AxiosHeaders.js:30) now handles arrays by mapping each element recursively (`value.map(normalizeValue)`) instead of coercing the whole array with `String(value)`, which joined cookie values into a single comma-separated string.

2. **`toJSON`** (lib/core/AxiosHeaders.js:329) now preserves array values (e.g. `set-cookie`) by default, and only joins them into a string when the new optional `asStrings` argument is passed.

This keeps `set-cookie` values as arrays through the entire pipeline — `set()`, `normalize()`, and `get('set-cookie')` — so `response.headers.get('set-cookie')` returns an array as expected.
